title: Triceratops bellow (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by National Park Service; King L, Soltis J, Douglas-Hamilton I, Savage A, Vollrath F
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (American bison bellow and African elephant rumble, pitched down and layered). Sound design from 2 real recordings: "Bison (NPS Sound Gallery)" 2.64–4.20 s, slowed to 0.7× speed (pitched down 30%); "Bee-Threat-Elicits-Alarm-Call-in-African-Elephants-pone.0010346.s003" 1.20–3.40 s; then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 28 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
